pushModeReplace.regime1_noTaskPassed: Unchanged: moving down by d shifts every other task with start >= originalStart by d (up: start <= originalStart).
pushModeReplace.passedRule_down: Candidates: others with start >= originalStart, midpoint > dragged original end, midpoint <= dragged LIVE end (liveStart + duration). Midpoints use ORIGINAL positions. Process in ascending midpoint order.
pushModeReplace.passedRule_up: Candidates: others with start <= originalStart, midpoint < dragged original start, midpoint >= dragged LIVE start. Process nearest first (descending midpoint).
pushModeReplace.regime2_swap: If any task passed: no pushing at all. Successive true swaps, gap between the pair is kept. Down: passed task starts at dragged task's current start; dragged task ends at passed task's original end. Up: passed task ends at dragged task's current end; dragged task starts at passed task's original start. Non-passed tasks stay put.
pushModeReplace.render: Dragged task shows at its computed slot (preview = what is saved), so it snaps on swap; others animate.
pushModeReplace.threshold: 'At least half' (>=) chosen over strict >; minor.
